# Should include user configuration paths.
zb configuration path
[!windows] stdout ^$HOME\Q/.config/zb/config.json\E$
[!windows] stdout ^$HOME\Q/.config/zb/config.jwcc\E$
[windows] stdout ^$AppData\Q\.config\zb\config.json\E$
[windows] stdout ^$AppData\Q\.config\zb\config.jwcc\E$

# Pass command-line flag.
[!windows] zb configuration path --config $HOME/foo/bar.json
[!windows] stdout \A$HOME\Q/foo/bar.json\E$
[windows] zb configuration path --config $UserProfile\foo\bar.json
[windows] stdout \A$UserProfile\Q\foo\bar.json\E$

# Set environment variable.
[!windows] env ZB_CONFIG_FILE=$HOME/foo/bar.json
[windows] env ZB_CONFIG_FILE=$UserProfile\foo\bar.json
zb configuration path
[!windows] stdout \A$HOME\Q/foo/bar.json\E$
[windows] stdout \A$UserProfile\Q\foo\bar.json\E$
